blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Industry leaders in the Philippines, Indonesia, and Vietnam have launched a regional partnership to speed up the shift from diesel to small solar-plus-storage systems in remote areas. The member organizations of the Asian Photovoltaic Industry Association (APVIA) in the three countries formalized their team-up during the Powering the Islands and Remote Communities through Solar and Battery Storage event at the 31st UN Climate Change Conference.
